content.comment_body: Hello! This is my first post on the forum. I appreciate the software provided—it's exactly what I needed. I have a question and hope someone still checks this thread. If I want to use a PT1000 sensor, which parameters should be modified? I assume changing [article_no] B012 alone is not enough, as it is currently set for a 0-50 degree range, while a PT1000 sensor measures between -50 and 200 degrees. Could someone please guide me? Best regards, [user_name]
Please refer to the attached file. Also, note that for a PT100/100 sensor, you need an extension module such as AM2 RTD.

Thank you for the quick reply. I'm not sure what I'm missing. I changed the block to a PT-type sensor, but now the threshold switch doesn't work. I've adjusted your example for my application, but that doesn't seem to be the issue. I'm new to working with analogue amplifiers, so I'm still learning. I'm attaching the diagram for reference. Thank you in advance.

Thanks again for the fast reply. I'm struggling to figure out what's wrong. I switched the block to a PT sensor, but now the threshold switch fails. I made modifications to the example to match my setup, though the issue persists. Analogue amplifiers are new to me, so it's a bit confusing. I’m attaching the diagram. Thanks in advance—turns out I needed to reduce the setpoint amplifier by one decimal. I think I’m making progress, but any further advice would be greatly appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The original poster thanks the community for the provided software and seeks instructions for configuring settings when using a PT1000 sensor. Changing sensor types leads to difficulties with the threshold switch, highlighting common challenges inexperienced users face when adapting hardware setups, especially in analogue signal processing and amplifier adjustment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user looks for clear advice on which settings need to be changed to properly use the PT1000 sensor and expects that updating the input sensor type and amplifier-related parameters will resolve the operational issue.
